convert_dpt_checkpoint: convert a DPT checkpoint from the original repository to a HuggingFace PyTorch model
get_dpt_config: get the DPT configuration and expected output shape from a checkpoint URL
rename_key: rename a state dict key from the original DPT format to HuggingFace DPT format
read_in_q_k_v: split concatenated qkv weight matrices into separate query, key, and value tensors
prepare_img: download and return a sample COCO image for verifying the converted model outputs
